blocks.content: JavaScript (JS) has a wide range of applications today, from web development to server-side programming and even mobile app creation.
However, JS began as a language built specifically for browsers, enabling interactivity on websites.
But what exactly does "interactivity" mean? Let's explore this on the next page.
